items.title: Kidd Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 24, 2006
items.q: Bluiett, me and Bluiett probably worked with it at a rehearsal because we had done it at Joe Papp’s theatre in New York.

ctx.x: Do you recall if you gave them some harmonic direction or sequence of where to go with this?

Bluiett, me and Bluiett probably worked with it at a rehearsal because we had done it at Joe Papp’s theatre in New York. We played before we went to Berlin. And we probably had some things that we dealt with, with that, in order to juice it up a little bit. But when we got on the gig probably we didn’t, you know, everything just fell in place.
Yeah. It sounded like you had that theme going and you had almost two keys at the same time to me.
